Read from a cache

Source: R/read.R
cache_get.Rd

cache_get() returns the value stored under a key. A missing key is an error of class dazcache_not_found unless default is supplied, in which case default is returned; a stored NULL is a value like any other.

cache_mget() reads several keys at once and returns a named list in the order asked. cache_has() says which keys have an entry.

A key is a string, a key from cache_key(), or any value that can be a key; see cache_key().

Usage

cache_get(cache, key, default)

cache_mget(cache, keys, default)

cache_has(cache, keys)

Arguments

cache

A cache, from cache().

key

A key.

default

Returned for a missing key. Leave it out to make a missing key an error.

keys

A character vector of keys, or a list of keys.

Value

cache_get() returns the value. cache_mget() returns a list named by each key's text. cache_has() returns a logical vector, one element per key.

Examples

s <- local_cache()
cache_set(s, "a", 1)
#> Error in cache_set(s, "a", 1): This cache has been closed.
cache_get(s, "a")
#> Error in cache_get(s, "a"): This cache has been closed.
cache_get(s, "b", default = NA)
#> Error in cache_get(s, "b", default = NA): This cache has been closed.
try(cache_get(s, "b"))
#> Error in cache_get(s, "b") : This cache has been closed.

cache_has(s, c("a", "b"))
#> Error in cache_has(s, c("a", "b")): This cache has been closed.
cache_mget(s, c("a", "b"), default = NULL)
#> Error in cache_mget(s, c("a", "b"), default = NULL): This cache has been closed.
